mods.name: Hyrule's Collection (QoL & Cheats)
mods.author: HyruleChosenOne
mods.tagline: Offline Mode events hub, selectable Daily Mutations, P2P multiplayer, Experimental Co-op Expeditions, live menu themes, solo cheats, and full profile unlocks.
mods.description: Offline Mode events hub, selectable Daily Mutations, P2P multiplayer, Experimental Co-op Expeditions, live menu themes, solo cheats, and full profile unlocks.
mods.fullDescription: All-in-one Offline Mode Quality-of-Life, Enablers, and Trainer Cheats collection by HyruleChosenOne. Past seasonal events and selectable Daily Mutations (Solo & Co-op) are enabled by default, alongside direct IP:Port P2P Co-op with Experimental Co-op Expeditions (2-4P), live 3D main menu wallpaper and music selectors, Solo Combat Cheats (auto-disabled in Co-op/Online) with Upgrade Rarity / Boost Luck, Free Rerolls, Always Crit, Rapid Cooldowns, and Shiny Magnet, plus full profile unlocks.
highlights: Past seasonal events & selectable Daily Mutations active by default (click any mutation icon in Solo or Co-op)
Direct IP:Port Peer-to-Peer Co-op with UDP Local Lobbies, centered Mod Sync popup, and Experimental Co-op Expeditions (2-4P)
Live 3D Main Menu Wallpaper and Music selector (supports additive custom music)

Solo Combat Cheats (auto-disabled in Co-op/Online): Run Speed 1x-3x, Upgrade Rarity / Boost Luck, God Mode, Overdrive, Turbo XP, Super Magnet, Instant Ultimate, Free Rerolls, Always Crit, Rapid Cooldowns, Shiny Magnet
Full Unlocks: Profile Customization, Clan & Rank Rewards, Wardrobe & Shinies, Max Friendship (Lv. 20), Complete All Quests

changes: Updated for PokéBonk v0.10.38.
Made Past Seasonal Events and Experimental Co-op Expeditions always ON by default (removed redundant toggles; labeled Co-op Expeditions with yellow EXPERIMENTAL badges in Co-op menus).
Added clickable Daily Mutation icon selection in both Solo and Co-op Mutation lobbies.

Auto-disables all live cheats when joining/hosting Co-op or switching to Online Mode, and added Upgrade Rarity / Boost Luck (Off / Boost Luck / Epic+ Only / Legendary Only), Free Rerolls, Always Crit, Rapid Cooldowns, and Shiny Magnet solo cheats.
Moved Co-op Mod Mismatch sync prompt into a centered modal popup, aligned Co-op Expedition enemy/XP scaling with normal Co-op, and enforced full squad ready-check + client launch guards.
Added Enable Solo Cheats (Pause Menu Access) toggle in Live Cheats so active live cheats can be adjusted directly inside the in-game Pause Menu during solo runs with no HUD while playing.
Added embedded collapsible support for the updated Mods Config layout across Desktop, Android, and iOS.

Integrated Co-op Expeditions (2-4P) as an Experimental toggle inside Hyrule's Collection (Core tab) with optional solo host launch, optional gear risk requirement, and +30s/+60s squad extraction regroup grace windows.

Added Expedition directly to the Co-op lobby Mode selector; selecting it seamlessly switches every player's UI into the full synced Co-op Expedition Base with every vanilla solo loadout, shop, refuge, route card, and wishlist option.
Moved Hyrule's Collection settings UI into its own modular config panel (config/panel.js) dynamically mounted inside Mods Config.
Verified full compatibility with PokéBonk v0.10.36 including P2P Co-op Expedition relay support and services-*.js error handling.
Added Unlock All (Full Profile Customization) covering icons, titles, frames, backgrounds, wardrobe skins, and Treasure wheels.
Added Unlock All Clan & Rank Rewards, Max Friendship (Lv. 20), and Complete All Quests save utilities.
Added direct IP:Port P2P Co-op Multiplayer with automatic UDP LAN Discovery and 1-click Co-op Mod Parity checks.
Reworked Solo Combat Cheats (Run Speed 1x-3x, God Mode, Overdrive, Turbo XP, Super Magnet & Luck, Instant Ultimate).

preservedVersions.note: Preserved release for PokéBonk Unbound v1.0.5 (Offline PokéBonk v0.10.31).

mods.name: Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack (14 Unique Maps)
mods.author: HyruleChosenOne
mods.tagline: 14 region-faithful procedural stages across Hoenn to Paldea with unique terrain profiles, decorative regional map features, custom textures, and 3D landmarks.
mods.description: 14 region-faithful procedural levels across Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, and Paldea using the updated Modding API with unique topographies, landmarks, decorative regional scenery, custom textures, and official region OSTs.
mods.fullDescription: Adds 14 custom stages across Hoenn to Paldea with distinct 3D topographies, landmarks, harmonized textures, and region OSTs.
highlights: Hoenn: Petalburg Canopy & Mt. Chimney Caldera
Sinnoh: Mt. Coronet Spear Pillar & Eterna Forest Chateau
Unova: Desert Resort Relic Castle & Dragonspiral Tower
Kalos: Azure Bay Sea Arch & Reflection Cave Prisms
Alola: Melemele Tapu Ruins & Wela Volcano Fire Altar
Galar: Galar Wild Area Dynamax Den & Crown Tundra Temple
Paldea: Asado Desert Titan Mesa & Area Zero Terastal Spire

changes: Rebuilt all 14 stages using the updated declarative procedural terrain API (proceduralGen, customPrefabs, prefabScatters, and localesDir) with zero legacy bundle patches.

Distinct region-faithful topography for every stage: Petalburg glades, Mt. Chimney molten lava moat caldera, Mt. Coronet alpine ridge, Eterna twilight river bog, Relic Desert parallel dunes, Dragonspiral moated spiral ascent, Azure Bay crescent cove & islet sandbar, Reflection Cave enclosed crystal interior, Melemele tropical lagoon, Wela Volcano spiral fissures, Galar Wild Area river moors, Crown Tundra frozen ice fjord, Asado stratified red mesas, and Area Zero 3-tier inverted crater.

Added purely decorative regional map scenery and landmarks (cable pylons, fluted columns, chateau iron lanterns, standing stones, Power Spot rock dens, Zero Lab beacons, and more) with no custom gameplay mechanics.
Fixed localization helper compatibility on PokéBonk v0.10.36.
Updated all 14 custom stages across Hoenn to Paldea with harmonized ground/path/cliff textures, 3D landmarks, and official region OSTs.
Replaced placeholder thumbnails with real in-game 3D level screenshots for every stage.
Added 11-language localization for all 7 regions and 14 stage names.

mods.requirements: Offline Mode (Mod Engine ON; works standalone or with National Dex Gen 3-9)

preservedVersions.note: Preserved release for PokéBonk Unbound v1.0.5 (Offline PokéBonk v0.10.31).

mods.summary: All 7 Gen 3-9 regions and 14 unique maps rebuilt on the updated procedural terrain API with faithful regional landforms, decorative map features, 14 stage OSTs, custom textures, and 11-language localization.

72 custom Gen 3-9 attacks across all 18 types rendered via PokéBonk native GPU VFX engine
24 custom Ultimates (Rayquaza, Lucario, Garchomp, Greninja, Zacian, Koraidon, Miraidon, Raging Bolt, Terapagos, and more)

mods.author: HyruleChosenOne

mods.description: Test & showcase mod demonstrating PokéBonk Unbound modding capabilities: custom fighters, movesets, VFX, SFX/cries, Wardrobe skins, and 3D stages.
mods.fullDescription: Note: This is a test/showcase mod built to demonstrate PokéBonk Unbound's modding capabilities rather than a polished standalone release. It showcases custom playable characters (Young Link with OOT cries & Princess Zelda with Wind Waker HD voice SFX, both unlocked by default), 6 Wardrobe skins each, dedicated exclusive movesets for both characters (9 Minish Cap sword/item moves for Link + 9 custom Triforce & Goddess magic moves for Zelda, zero vanilla PokéBonk moves), Light Arrows Signature Fusion, custom Ultimates, and 2 unlocked 3D stages (Hyrule Castle & Pyramid of Power) with looping ALttP SNES OSTs.
highlights: Test/showcase mod demonstrating custom characters, movesets, VFX, SFX, Wardrobe skins, fusions, and 3D landmarks
Playable Young Link (#2010, OOT 3D cries) & Princess Zelda (#2024, Wind Waker HD voice SFX) — both unlocked by default
Separate exclusive movesets: 9 Minish Cap Sword/Item moves for Link + 9 Goddess & Triforce Magic moves for Zelda (zero vanilla moves)
6 Wardrobe skins each + Light Arrows Fusion + 3D Hyrule Castle & Pyramid of Power stages with looping ALttP OSTs
